title: Psalms 7
paragraphs: ¹ LORD my God, I take refuge in you; save me and rescue me from all who pursue me, ² or they will tear me apart like a lion, ripping me to pieces with no one to save me. ³ LORD my God, if I have done this, if there is guilt on my hands — ⁴ if I have repaid my ally with evil or unjustly robbed my foe — ⁵ then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample me to the ground and lay my honor in the dust. Selah.

⁶ Arise, LORD, in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake for me, you have decreed justice. ⁷ Let the assembly of peoples gather around you; rule over them from on high. ⁸ Let the LORD judge the peoples. Vindicate me, LORD, according to my righteousness and my integrity. ⁹ End the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure — you, the righteous God who probes minds and hearts. ¹⁰ My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

¹¹ God is a righteous judge, a God who shows his wrath every day. ¹² If a person does not repent, God will sharpen his sword; he has strung his bow and made it ready. ¹³ He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes his arrows flaming shafts. ¹⁴ See how the wicked conceive evil; they are pregnant with trouble and give birth to lies. ¹⁵ They dig a pit and hollow it out — and fall into the hole they have made.

¹⁶ Their trouble comes back on their own heads; their violence comes down on their own skulls. ¹⁷ I will give thanks to the LORD because of his righteousness; I will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
